subject: quick q
body: how much is it to clear a clogged kitchen sink, and are you guys open saturdays? Thx

evidence.anchor: Drain cleaning, one fixture (sink, tub, shower or toilet): $149 (starting price)
on Saturday from 8:00 am to noon

notes: Two questions in one line. Hours and what the business does are labelled service_question; terms such as warranty or cancellation are policy_question. The draft must answer both and say the $149 is a starting price.
